segments.name: Retail Automotive
products: third-party extended service and maintenance contracts
segments.description: Retails new and used vehicles and provides parts, service, finance and insurance, and collision repair at franchised dealerships in the U.S. and internationally.
segments.evidence: The individual dealership operations included in the Retail Automotive reportable segment represent two operating segments: United States Retail Automotive and International Retail Automotive.

segments.name: Retail Commercial Truck
segments.description: Operates heavy- and medium-duty truck dealerships in the U.S. and Canada, selling new and used trucks and providing service and parts to fleets.
segments.evidence: Our Retail Commercial Truck reportable segment has been determined to represent one operating segment and reporting unit.

segments.name: Other
products: MAN heavy- and medium-duty trucks and buses
segments.description: Distributes commercial vehicles, diesel and gas engines, power systems and parts, principally in Australia and New Zealand, to on- and off-highway customers.
segments.evidence: The goodwill included in our Other reportable segment relates primarily to our commercial vehicle distribution operating segment.

segments.name: Non-Automotive Investments
segments.description: Holds equity method investments in non-automotive operations, principally Penske Transportation Solutions, a truck leasing, rental and logistics business.
segments.evidence: Penske Transportation Solutions ("PTS") is the universal brand name for PTL's various businesses, which articulates the breadth of their services.

revenueModel.text: Retail consumers and fleet customers pay us for new and used vehicles, parts and service, finance and insurance products, and for distributed commercial vehicles, engines and power systems.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to selling new and used vehicles, we generate higher-margin revenue at each of our dealerships through maintenance and repair services, the sale and placement of third-party finance and insurance products, third-party extended service and maintenance contracts, replacement and aftermarket automotive products, and at certain of our locations, collision repair services.

changes.text: In 2023 the company recorded goodwill impairment charges related to its former Used Vehicle Dealerships International reporting unit.
changes.evidence: Retail automotive segment income includes $ 40.7 million of goodwill impairment charges in 2023 related to our former Used Vehicle Dealerships International reporting unit.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold and closed retail automotive franchises in the U.S. within its Retail Automotive segment.
changes.evidence: During 2025, in the U.S. we sold four retail automotive franchises, closed one retail automotive franchise, and opened one retail automotive franchise.
